/* saleson.shop.order.givepoint.OrderGivePointMapper.getGiveBlcePointListByUserId */
SELECT CNTR.CNTR_SN , CNTR.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE , CNTR.PSITN_LOCGOV_CODE , SUM(CNTR.CNTR_POINT) AS CNTR_POINT , IFNULL(SUM(CNTR.CNTR_BLCE_POINT), 0) AS CNTR_BLCE_POINT FROM ( SELECT C.CNTR_SN , C.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE , C.PSITN_LOCGOV_CODE , C.CNTR_POINT
, (C.CNTR_POINT - SUM(ABS(IFNULL(CUP.CNTR_USE_POINT, 0)))) AS CNTR_BLCE_POINT
FROM G_CNTR C , G_CNTR_USE_POINT CUP WHERE 1=1 AND C.CNTR_SN = CUP.CNTR_SN(+) AND C.USER_ID = #{value} AND C.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND C.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND C.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND C.POINT_END_DE >= TO_CHAR(CURDATE(), 'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY C.CNTR_SN ) CNTR GROUP BY CNTR.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE

/* saleson.shop.order.givepoint.OrderGivePointMapper.getGiveBlcePointListByUserIdAndLocgov */
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT C.CNTR_SN , C.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE , C.PSITN_LOCGOV_CODE , C.CNTR_POINT
, C.POINT_END_DE , (C.CNTR_POINT - SUM(ABS(IFNULL(CUP.CNTR_USE_POINT, 0)))) AS CNTR_BLCE_POINT FROM G_CNTR C , G_CNTR_USE_POINT CUP WHERE 1=1 AND C.CNTR_SN = CUP.CNTR_SN(+) AND C.USER_ID = #{userId} AND C.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND C.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND C.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND C.POINT_END_DE >= TO_CHAR(CURDATE(), 'YYYYMMDD') AND C.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{cntrLocgovCode} GROUP BY C.CNTR_SN ) CNTR WHERE 1=1
AND CNTR.CNTR_BLCE_POINT > 0

/* saleson.shop.order.givepoint.OrderGivePointMapper.getGiveBlcePointListByCntrSn */
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT C.CNTR_SN , C.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE , C.PSITN_LOCGOV_CODE , C.CNTR_POINT
, (C.CNTR_POINT - SUM(ABS(IFNULL(CUP.CNTR_USE_POINT, 0)))) AS CNTR_BLCE_POINT , C.POINT_END_DE FROM G_CNTR C , G_CNTR_USE_POINT CUP WHERE 1=1 AND C.CNTR_SN = CUP.CNTR_SN(+) AND C.CNTR_SN = #{cntrSn} AND C.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND C.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND C.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200'
AND C.POINT_END_DE >= TO_CHAR(CURDATE(), 'YYYYMMDD')
GROUP BY C.CNTR_SN ) CNTR WHERE 1=1
AND CNTR.CNTR_BLCE_POINT > 0

mapper.select: /* saleson.shop.order.givepoint.OrderGivePointMapper.getGivePayOrder */ SELECT SUM(A.SALE_PRICE * A.QUANTITY * 1.0) AS SUM_PRICE, MAX(LOCGOV_CODE) AS CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE , MAX(USER_ID) AS USER_ID FROM OP_ORDER_ITEM A WHERE 1=1 AND A.ORDER_CODE = #{orderCode}

/* saleson.shop.order.givepoint.OrderGivePointMapper.selectItemStockInfo */ SELECT A.ORDER_CODE, B.ITEM_ID, A.QUANTITY AS BUY_QUANTITY, A.OPTIONS, B.STOCK_FLAG, B.STOCK_QUANTITY, B.ITEM_OPTION_TYPE FROM OP_ORDER_ITEM A INNER JOIN OP_ITEM B ON A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.ORDER_CODE = #{orderCode}
